said: Budgets for an adult learning English

scenes.teach: A budget is a plan for your money. You write down the money that comes in, your income, and the money that goes out, your spending.
says: A budget is a plan for your money.
First, write down the money you get.
Next, write down the money you spend.

scenes.teach: Group your spending: needs, like rent and food, and wants, like new clothes or meals out. Pay for needs first.
says: Some things you need, like rent and food.
Some things you want, like new clothes.
Pay for the things you need first.

scenes.teach: If you spend less than your income, you can save the rest. Check your budget every month and change it when your life changes.
says: Try to spend less than your income.
Then you can save the rest.
Look at your budget every month.
